name: Amplify RED IV - Eucalyptus
description: Powered By Near Infrared Amplify surrounds you with red + near-infrared photobiomodulation (PBM) purposefully integrated throughout the sauna, layering four energy technologies engineered around how the body receives light and heat. Thick insulation, double-pane glass doors and enhanced heaters push temperatures up to 170°F.* Relax completely and recover more deeply with a deeper, faster sweat.
